items.quote:
A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
8  left that town
items.contrast: The Levite’s place of departure, Bethlehem, versus the place he later reaches, Micah’s house in Ephraim.
items.reason: “That town” refers to Bethlehem in Judah. Micah’s house is where he came afterward, not where he set out from, so the key uniquely resolves the origin-versus-destination distinction.
